summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The candidate adds a valid focused regression for the KDA CPU-sequence-length opt-out, but changes no implementation. The recorded base already contains the reporter-confirmed source fix from upstream PR 32219. Independent GPU-path testing confirmed that the false flag avoids CPU sequence-length publication while the old true behavior selects the D2H path. The original nondeterministic TP8 Kimi-K3 serving hang was not independently reproduced or qualified.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's four scheduler-decision regression and boundary cases passed at the exact candidate commit.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 prepared-python inline adversarial call to FutureMap.resolve_seq_lens_cpu with needs_cpu_seq_lens=False and True
tests.what_was_measured: On MI350X/gfx950, False retained GPU seq_lens and set seq_lens_cpu/seq_lens_sum to None; the adversarial True control produced CPU value [7] and sum 7, directly exercising the production D2H gate.
The production KDA Triton path passed 10 numerical subcases against its PyTorch reference on one MI350X/gfx950; this is kernel evidence, not a TP8 serving-hang reproduction.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015 executed the independent FutureMap branch check and KDA Triton fixture. Candidate-retained evidence was from a different gfx950 product, MI355X.
native_rebuild_reason: The exact candidate changes only a Python unit test and report artifacts; it changes no C++, FlyDSL, extension, or other native source.
remaining_counterexamples: The 8xMI350X TP8 Kimi-K3 MXFP4 DSPARK workload and its approximately 3% permanent c=1 hang were not independently reproduced or stress-tested after the fix.
The unit test checks scheduler selection but cannot exclude unrelated blocking D2H operations elsewhere in the complete serving path.
A one-GPU KDA kernel fixture cannot validate distributed stream ordering, full-model DSPARK integration, or long-run hang frequency.
remaining_limitations: Only one MI350X/gfx950 was assigned and Kimi-K3 MXFP4 weights plus the TP8 DSPARK deployment were unavailable. The candidate is verified as test-only hardening; full original-workload resolution remains dependent on the reporter's original-scale evidence.
